regime.label: Stressed, still above our VIX limit
regime.summary: Wed close: S&P 500 7,195 (-0.1%) after -2.8% intraday, Nasdaq -0.5%, Dow +0.7%; VIX about 27.8 at 15:08 ET. Core PCE 3.3% vs 3.2% expected; a Dec 9 Fed hike is about 97-98% priced. USTR proposed Section 301 tariffs on 14 economies (EU 15%, Switzerland up to 15%). US closed Thu; half day Fri (closes 22:00 Dubai).

brief: Wild day: the S&P 500 fell almost 3% on hot inflation, AI fears and a new US tariff plan, then closed flat; VIX still near 28. The US proposed a tariff of up to 15% on Swiss goods, so the Richemont Friday plan is off: no new orders, hold Nvidia.

todo.focus: US closed today (Thanksgiving). No new order. Richemont Friday plan is off.

items.text: Richemont is WAIT: Friday plan cancelled (US proposed a 15% Swiss tariff). Place no CFR order
Nvidia fell about 5% Wed to about $148: HOLD. Huang meets Congress Dec 1, testifies Dec 3
Fri half day (closes 22:00 Dubai): no lab trade while VIX is above 25 (about 28 now)

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: WAIT. Keep the limit BUY 6 SPYM at $78.50, good till Wed Dec 9. Do not raise it: VIX is near 28. If not filled after the Fed, a new limit on Dec 10.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. 3.5% below its high after a -3% month.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: WAIT. Friday plan is off: the US proposed a tariff of up to 15% on Swiss goods. No order. Reconsider after the US decision (hearings from Jan 25), red team first.
cards.story: Net profit +39% while luxury peers grow 1-2%. Q2 slowed to +13%; analyst average target about CHF 210.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. It closed $319.27 (-5.1%), about 3.6% above its 52-week low of $308.22. Reconsider only after 2 closes in a row above $330, then red team first.
cards.story: Sales +28% (organic +19%), full-year guide raised. 29% below its high at about 22x next year's profit.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit filled. WAIT on a second slice until the 2027 capex figure (early Feb) and search growth of at least 12%.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled (+103%) and search still grew 12%. The Oct 29 profit miss was partly an $8.7B one-off investment loss.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order. Fell 6-10% with European chips, far under EUR 48.50. Reconsider only after 3 closes in a row above EUR 48.50 and no US chip export rule hits Europe.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips, but the cash flow guide is below hopes. The drop is chip-sector mood.

cards.name: Intuitive Surgical (da Vinci)
cards.trigger: WAIT. When VIX closes below 25: red team first, then BUY 1 with a limit at $415 or the last close, whichever is lower. Not now: up about 9% in 3 sessions.
cards.story: Healthcare leader outside AI chips: revenue +22%, procedures about +15%. Trades 28% below its 52-week high of $603.88.

cards.name: Microsoft
cards.trigger: WAIT. No order now. After the Fed decision (Wed Dec 9): BUY 1 with a limit at $460, only if VIX is below 25 and MSFT has not closed below $440.
cards.story: Revenue grows about 19% with Azure +48%. But bookings fell and capex is about $170B a year, so buy only lower.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: WAIT. The old EUR 235 limit may have filled (SU traded EUR 232.15); if not, cancel it. No new order before full-year results (late Feb 2027); then BUY 2 at EUR 224.
cards.story: Organic growth +16.9%, record backlog, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal financing, not slower demand.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: WAIT. BUY 1 only after a close above $385, with a limit at that close or $395, whichever is lower.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%, Jan-Oct +43.3%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Cisco
cards.trigger: WATCH. No order. Reconsider only if CSCO closes at or below $87 before Fri Dec 11 with VIX under 25 (red team first); else after the February report.
cards.story: 26-30% below its high after a beat, but services grew only 1% and next quarter is guided lower. Margin fell on memory costs.

cards.name: CrowdStrike buys Zscaler
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider only after the deal filing (S-4) shows Zscaler's numbers and CRWD then closes above $210 for 5 sessions.
cards.story: Fell about 9-10% on an all-stock deal for a slower grower. The quarter is fine but the Q4 guide slows; JPMorgan sees dilution.

cards.name: Analog Devices
cards.trigger: WATCH. The close above $337 test failed (Tue close $312.95). Reconsider after its next report (about Feb 2027) only if the Q2 guide grows; red team first.
cards.story: Record quarter, but EPS is guided down about 6% on flat sales at about 30x earnings. Mixed, not mood.

cards.name: Micron
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy: more AI-chip exposure. Reconsider after mid-December results (Dec 17) only if the gross margin guide stays above 85%; red team first.
cards.story: Fell about 11% on a BNP Paribas downgrade. Growth is almost all memory price and the margin guide already slips: mixed, not mood.

cards.name: ASM International · Amsterdam
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after full-year results (about late Feb 2027) only if the 2027 sales target above EUR 5.7B is kept and the US MATCH Act has not passed.
cards.story: Record Q3 revenue (+44%), but no quarterly order data, an easy 2025 base and US China-sales risk. Mixed, not mood.

cards.name: ASML
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after Q4 results and the 2027 outlook (about Jan 27) only if the MATCH Act has not passed and 2027 sales are guided above 2026.
cards.story: Fell 5.6% with the AI chip selloff. A US bill could ban DUV tool sales and service in China: a rule risk, so mixed.

cards.name: SAP
cards.trigger: WATCH. No buy. Reconsider after Q4 results (late Jan 2027) only if current cloud backlog growth stays at 25% or more; red team first.
cards.story: Down about 11% in a week. Cloud is fine, but support, licenses and services shrink and backlog growth is guided to slow. Mixed.

agenda.event: US markets closed (Thanksgiving); Rheinmetall capital markets day (Nov 26-27)
CrowdStrike, Marvell, Credo (after close); Huang meets House committees
Huang testifies to the Senate Banking Committee
Comment deadline on the US Section 301 tariff plan
